title: Implement a Simple SSR App: Build a Basic Server-Rendered Page
problem_statement:
Build a simple server-side rendered web application using Node.js and Express. The application should render HTML on the server and serve it to the client.

Requirements:

1. Express server setup:
   - Create an Express server
   - Configure server to listen on a port (e.g., 3000)
   - Use template engine (EJS or Pug) for rendering
   - Configure template engine views directory

2. Home page:
   - GET / route that renders a home page
   - Page should have a header, navigation, and content
   - Content should include dynamic data (e.g., current date, user count)
   - Use template engine to inject dynamic data into HTML

3. Dynamic page:
   - GET /posts/:id route that renders a post page
   - Fetch post data from a simple in-memory data store
   - If post exists, render page with post data
   - If post doesn't exist, render a 404 page

4. About page:
   - GET /about route that renders an about page
   - Page should include static content about the application
   - Use the same layout as other pages (header, navigation)

5. Shared layout:
   - Create a shared layout template (header, navigation, footer)
   - Include CSS styling (inline or in a style tag)
   - All pages should use the shared layout
   - Navigation should link to home, posts, and about pages

6. Data handling:
   - Create an in-memory data store with sample posts
   - Each post should have: id, title, content, author, date
   - Include at least 3 sample posts

Use Express.js, EJS or Pug template engine. Do not use client-side JavaScript frameworks (React, Vue, etc.).
instructions: Submit exactly one .js file containing the complete SSR application. Include server setup, routes, template code in comments, and data store. Separate templates using comments with === FILE: path ===. Do not submit a folder or ZIP.

rubrics.criterion: Express server and template engine setup
rubrics.full: Sets up Express server correctly, configures template engine (EJS or Pug), and defines views directory.
rubrics.partial: Sets up server but template engine configuration is missing or incorrect.
rubrics.zero: Server setup is missing or incorrect.

rubrics.full: Implements GET / route that renders home page with header, navigation, and dynamic data injected via template engine.
rubrics.partial: Home page exists but lacks dynamic data or template engine usage.

rubrics.criterion: Dynamic post page with data handling
rubrics.full: Implements GET /posts/:id route that fetches from in-memory data store, renders post page if found, and renders 404 if not found.
rubrics.partial: Post page exists but data handling is incomplete or 404 handling is missing.

rubrics.full: Creates shared layout template (header, navigation, footer), implements GET /about route, and all pages use the shared layout with navigation.
rubrics.partial: Layout or about page exists but shared layout is incomplete or navigation is missing.
rubrics.zero: Shared layout or about page is missing.

valid_alternatives: Use EJS or Pug (both are acceptable).
Add more sample posts if desired.
Use different styling approach as long as CSS is included.
mistakes_to_check: Not using template engine (Manual HTML rendering).
Not injecting dynamic data (Static content only).
Not handling 404 for missing posts (Error handling).
Not using in-memory data store (Database usage is fine but data should be provided).
